license_required.quote: Any person, firm, or corporation not being duly authorized who shall engage in the business of general contracting in this state, except as provided for in this chapter, and any person, firm, or corporation presenting or attempting to file as its own the license certificate of another, or who shall give false or forged evidence of any kind to the board...shall be deemed guilty of a Class A misdemeanor

required.quote: the board shall investigate thoroughly the financial responsibility and past record of all applicants, which will include an effort towards ascertaining the qualifications of an applicant in reading plans and specifications, estimating costs, construction ethics, and other similar matters

exams.name: General Contractor Licensing Examination
exams.notes: Written or oral examination up to three days; board may waive or require based on application review. Subcontractors are not required to sit for any examination.
exams.quote: If the application is satisfactory to the board, then the applicant may be required to take an examination to determine his or her qualifications.

interval_years.quote: The certificate of authority to engage in the business of general contracting in the State of Alabama shall expire 12 months following its issuance or renewal and shall become invalid on that date unless renewed.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: two hundred dollars ($200) in case of a renewal

available.quote: A licensee may apply for and, on proof satisfactory to the board, may receive an increase in the amount of his or her bid limit, change his or her classification, or verify his or her license with a reciprocating state for fees not greater than seventy-five dollars ($75) as set by the board.

definition_quote.value: a 'general contractor' is defined to be one who, for a fixed price, commission, fee, or wage, undertakes to construct or superintend or engage in the construction, alteration, maintenance, repair, rehabilitation, remediation, reclamation, or demolition of any building, highway, sewer, structure, site work, grading, paving, or project or any improvement in the State of Alabama where the cost of the undertaking is one hundred thousand dollars ($100,000) or more
